title: At 81, Al Michaels has no plans to retire and is still 'a bit of a rascal'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: At 81, Al Michaels has no plans to retire and is still 'a bit of a rascal'
sources.description: Al Michaels will call the "Thursday Night Football" game with the Bills hosting the Lions in new Highmark Stadium, which will be his 10th stadium debut game.
